name: DropWatch
description: A client module that sends site update/telemetry data to the DropWatch update-monitoring SaaS.
project_description:
This module is required to integrate your Drupal site with DropWatch .

 Installation 
 Install in the usual manner.

 composer require drupal/dropwatch 

 What is DropWatch? 
 DropWatch is an app that synchronises all of your Drupal site information into one place. So, when security updates are released, you can look in one place to see which of your sites are affected.

 This saves you time by looking through each of your sites to see what modules they use to see if you need to carry out security updates.

 Features 
 
 Real-time monitoring - Always know when new security patches are released — no delays, no guesswork. 
 Time Savings - Stop manually checking updates — DropWatch automates the process so you can focus on what matters. 
 Risk Reduction - Protect your site, data, and users by closing vulnerabilities before attackers find them. 
 Slack Integration (Coming soon!) - Get notified the moment your Drupal site needs attention, so you can act fast. 
 
 Post-Installation 
 There is full documentation on how to set up your Drupal site with DropWatch, once you get access to the app.

 Additional Requirements 
 This module does require an account with DropWatch
